flavor.text: Not even Bramblin knows where it is headed as it tumbles across the wilderness, blown by the wind. It loathes getting wet.
A soul unable to move on to the afterlife was blown around by the wind until it got tangled up with dried grass and became a Pokémon.

abilities.name: Wind Rider
abilities.description: Boosts the Pokémon's Attack stat if Tailwind takes effect or if the Pokémon is hit by a wind move. The Pokémon also takes no damage from wind moves.

abilities.name: Infiltrator
abilities.description: The Pokémon's moves are unaffected by the target's barriers, substitutes, and the like.

children.name: Brambleghast
children.condition: Level up, after 1000 steps with you
